prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: Nonmembers can drop off blankets on Sundays only, and they need an appointment. My cousin isn’t a member. What should she do?
spokenPromptZh: 非會員只能在星期日送交毛毯，而且需要預約。我的表親不是會員。她應該怎麼做？

options.text: Drop it off this Sunday without an appointment.
options.zh: 這星期日不用預約，直接送去。
options.whyZh: 星期日符合可送交的日期，但仍未安排必要的預約。

options.text: Make an appointment to drop it off on Saturday.
options.zh: 預約星期六把毯子送去。
options.whyZh: 有預約，但非會員不能在星期六送交毛毯。
把非會員的兩個限制一起套用，預約並選星期日送去。

explanationZh: 把非會員的兩個限制一起套用，預約並選星期日送去。
evidence: Nonmembers can drop off blankets on Sundays only, and they need an appointment. My cousin isn’t a member. What should she do? / Book a Sunday drop-off.
